The event for which the value, x, of the first component is larger than or equal to the value, y, of the second component correspond to the points below the line y = x. In the rectangle [0,1]x[0,1], this forms a triangle with vertices (0,0), (1,1), and (1,0). Thus, the area of this event is 1/2. 

Given that the probability of an event under this uniform probability law is half of the area, the probability of this event is (1/2) * (1/2) = 1/4.
